scope: Measured diagnostic right-moving green Koopa shell-launched Goomba horizontal movement and immediate body orientation only. Score origins, source contact threshold, vertical motor, left-moving hits and other victim types remain unqualified.

rule.firstPostHitPose: Vertically flipped normal16x16Goomba, not flattened; body anchor preserves the prior16x16origin before vertical displacement.
rule.horizontalUpdateOrderCandidate: No horizontal teleport at defeat; first+1 update occurs on the following active native update. Death-frame phase stays an uncertainty until bracketed.
rule.verticalMotor: Excluded from candidate. Existing source samples do not qualify current uncapped vertical motor; report raw Y separately.

validation: Use independently changed6decision reverse approach. Register camera with actual static PNG pixels. Initialize each fully visible post-hit track once from its first actual image only, then predict subsequent X using actual active native durations. Report every matching pose and failure. This is conditional-motion proof, not an exact event-origin pass.
